title: Light Roasted Thai Dried White Corn Kanom Jeen
description: A comforting Thai street dish featuring roasted dried white corn in a light and flavorful mother sauce, perfect for a paleo-friendly meal. This dish is a classic Bangkok street food with a twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Spread the soaked and drained dried white corn on a baking sheet and roast for 10 minutes.
In a blender or food processor, combine the coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, grated ginger, and minced lemongrass, and blend until smooth.
In a large saucepan, combine the blended mixture and roasted dried white corn, and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for an additional 5 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the Light Roasted Thai Dried White Corn Kanom Jeen hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
